title: Generic Lambdas: compose, allOf, groupReduce, running mean
hints: compose: capture f and g by value (they may be temporaries) and return `[f, g](auto&& x) { return g(f(std::forward<decltype(x)>(x))); }`.
allOf: capture the pack by value, `[=](const auto& x) { ... }`, and use a C++17 fold `(preds(x) && ...)`. An empty && fold is `true`.
groupReduce: `auto& acc = out.try_emplace(key(item), init).first->second; acc = op(acc, item);`.
makeRunningMean: `[n = 0, mean = 0.0](double x) mutable { ++n; mean += (x - mean) / n; return mean; }`, an incremental mean with no growing sum.
